# nercone.dev

This website is a personal website run as a hobby by an individual (student) named Nercone. It features a self-introduction, a collection of links, various tools, and design experiment pages.

The primary language is Japanese.

## Pages

- [/](https://nercone.dev/) The top page displaying a daily changing message
- [/about](https://nercone.dev/about/) Self-introduction of the site administrator
- [/about/server](https://nercone.dev/about/server/) Details of this site's server configuration (HTTP/3, TLS, post-quantum cryptography support, etc.)
- [/links](https://nercone.dev/links/) Mutual link collection
- [/public-keys](https://nercone.dev/public-keys/) PGP public key for contact
- [/design](https://nercone.dev/design/) The design system for this site
- [/robots.txt](https://nercone.dev/robots.txt)
- [/sitemap.xml](https://nercone.dev/sitemap.xml)
- [/api/v1/status](https://nercone.dev/api/v1/status) Server uptime status (JSON)

## Source Code

The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/nercone-dev/website/. Most parts can be viewed here, except for sections that are difficult to make public due to third-party software, confidential information, or similar reasons.

No CMS such as WordPress or site builders are used. A custom web server built by combining FastAPI, Jinja2, and other tools operates as the backend.

## Contact

Please get in touch via [email](mailto:nercone@nercone.dev).
OpenPGP is available for email communication. The public key can be obtained from [this page](https://nercone.dev/public-keys/).

When reporting vulnerabilities, please read [security.txt](https://nercone.dev/.well-known/security.txt).

## Regarding Use by AI

According to the `Content-Signal` in [robots.txt](https://nercone.dev/robots.txt), search and use as AI input (ai-input) are permitted, but use for AI training (ai-train) is not permitted. Please follow this policy. Some crawlers are individually blocked in robots.txt.

You can retrieve pages in Markdown format by appending `.md` to the HTML page URL or by sending a request with the `Accept: text/markdown` header.
